notes.title: Version 1.0.8.0 Now Available
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.8.0 has now been released for Tactics Ogre: Reborn.

Update contents:
Fixed an issue that prevents the game from progressing upon typing/ inputting letters.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7.0 Now Available
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.7.0 has now been released for Tactics Ogre: Reborn.

Update contents:
- Bug fix to prevent inputs being disabled after the frequent use of the Chariot Tarot
- Bug fix to prevent the game crashing when accessing the Chariot Tarot
- Bug fix to prevent selection issues during battle when using mouse controls
- Various minor bug fixes and general stability improvements

notes.title: Version 1.0.6.0 Now Available
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.6.0 has now been released for Tactics Ogre: Reborn.

Update contents:
- Bug fixes relating to parameters, finishing moves, and weapon skills of weapons obtained by defeating the Dark Knights
- Bug fix to address the availability of Musical Instruments I in shops

notes.title: Version 1.0.5.0 Now Available
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.5.0 has now been released for Tactics Ogre: Reborn.

Update contents:
-Stability improvement during long play sessions.
-Bug fix to address game freezes when repeatedly using the Chariot Tarot.
-Added support for systems with multiple display adapters.
-Corrected description text for New Xenobia.
-Fixed several text issues in the English, French, and Simplified Chinese translations.
-Various minor bug fixes and general stability improvements.

notes.title: Tactics Ogre: Reborn will release on November 11, 2022. Prepurchase is now open!
notes.notes:
Tactics Ogre, crown jewel of the tactical role-playing genre, is reborn! Based on the 2010 release, the game features improved graphics and sound, as well as updated game design, bringing to life a new Tactics Ogre that remains true to its roots.

[b]Standard Edition Pre-Order Bonus[/b]
Tactics Ogre: Reborn Digital Mini Soundtrack

A selection of three songs from the Tactics Ogre: Reborn Original Soundtrack. Composed by Hitoshi Sakimoto and recorded live, these pieces are sure to delight.

*This bonus content may become available for purchase at a later date.

[b]Digital Premium Edition Pre-Order Bonus[/b]
Tactics Ogre (1995) Digital Mini Soundtrack

A selection of ten chiptune songs from the original Tactics Ogre, released in 1995. Perfected back in the day, these chiptune originals have a slightly different feel from the rerecorded live music found in Tactics Ogre: Reborn.

*This bonus content may become available for purchase at a later date.
